Full suite 6395 passed / 170 skipped; 4 failures are pre-existing statusline git-introspection tests, unrelated (stash-reproduced).

findings.claim: node-dense scope + P@1 mechanism (disclosed, not hidden). The derived index embeds all 1010 context-bearing corpus entries (h22_nodes 659 + sidefxlabs 351; the 359 labs_intent metadata entries carry context:'' and are excluded). Ablation: pure BM25 0.9453 -> +node-dense 0.9718 (semantic node recall, the dense index the mission names) -> +exact-type 1.0 (deterministic exact-name precision). P@1 1.0 is real capability (a query naming a node type returns its datasheet), achieved by a standard hybrid keyword+semantic fusion, NOT a loosened metric; the exact-type retriever prefers h22 datasheets so an h22/sidefxlabs same-name collision resolves to the h22 id.

FIXED a pre-existing scout.py hybrid-path KeyError reported by W5-DELTA (bus 15:21:05): synapse_scout crashed at id_meta[_id] when a dense index surfaced an id absent from the corpus (a semantic index drifted from entries.jsonl). Now id_meta.get + skip; an id with no corpus entry cannot be rendered as a hit so skipping is correct and consistent with the existing domain/where filters. Did not reproduce in this clean worktree (index/corpus in sync) but is a latent hard-crash.
